# NEXOVONARSA CORPORATION — Corporate Project Control Center

Internal-style single-page dashboard for monitoring the 2026–2030 corporate project portfolio.

## Included
- Corporate dashboard and status KPIs
- Companies and business-unit overview
- Central Projects database with search and filters
- Project detail modal with corporate-control fields
- Roadmap 2026–2030 and management hierarchy
- Calendar/review cadence, milestones and tasks
- Reports, risks, budget, documents and decisions
- Notifications, team view and audit/activity log
- CSV export of the current project filter
- Responsive dark corporate interface with animated buttons and subtle shadows
- System Health page for automated telemetry and integrity checks
- Scraper Sources page for public metadata monitoring
- Automated repository validator for data, routes, links and source integrity
- 10-language interface: Indonesia, English, Melayu, Tiếng Việt, ไทย, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, العربية, Español
- Email/password login, registration, password reset and Google OAuth UI
- Account/profile state and settings for language, theme, reduced motion and auto-refresh
- PWA shell and responsive touch-friendly layout for desktop, tablet and mobile
- Static deployment, no build step required

## Files
- `index.html` — application shell
- `styles.css` — responsive corporate UI
- `data.js` — companies, roadmap and alerts
- `portfolio.js` — project portfolio baseline
- `app.js` — dashboard logic, filters, detail view and CSV export
- `scripts/sync-github.mjs` — GitHub repository intelligence sync
- `scripts/scrape-public.mjs` — public HTTPS metadata scraper with robots, retries, size/type/redirect safety and generated telemetry
- `scripts/validate.mjs` — automated structural/data validation\n- `scripts/smoke-test.mjs` — route-level browser-runtime smoke test\n- `gateway/server.mjs` — optional Node.js static gateway with `/api/health` and `/api/version`\n- `gateway/test.mjs` — gateway integration smoke test\n- `package.json` — npm scripts for check, smoke, test, gateway, scraper and GitHub sync
- `scrape-config.json` — public scraper source registry
- `external-live.js` — generated scraper snapshot\n- `icons/` — installable PWA icon assets
- `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` — GitHub Pages deployment

## Data governance
The baseline follows the supplied Corporate Project Roadmap. Progress is shown only when an authoritative value exists in the project registry; otherwise it remains `TBD`. PIC, target, budget and similar operational fields remain `TBD` until the responsible project owner supplies actual data. The dashboard does not invent operational metrics.

**Last Update:** 10/08/2026  
**Planning Period:** 2026–2030  
**Document Owner:** NEXOVONARSA CORPORATION

## Live GitHub integration
The Corporate Control Center now has a **Repository Intelligence** page. It synchronizes the owner's GitHub repositories through the GitHub API instead of maintaining a hand-edited project list.

### What is synchronized
- Repository inventory and visibility
- Repository URL, default branch, language and size
- Latest push/update timestamps
- Latest commit
- Open issues and pull requests
- Branch count
- Latest GitHub Actions workflow state
- Corporate mapping (company, business unit and project)

### Refresh model
GitHub Actions runs repository synchronization and public metadata scraping every **15 minutes** and commits `github-live.js` plus `external-live.js` when data changes. This is near-real-time polling, not a permanent WebSocket connection. GitHub Pages remains static, so the design does not expose a GitHub token to browser JavaScript.

### Private repositories
For cross-repository private-data access, create a GitHub fine-grained token with the minimum required read access and save it as the repository secret **GH_PAT**. Do not put the token in source files.

Without `GH_PAT`, the workflow falls back to `GITHUB_TOKEN`, which is intentionally limited by GitHub Actions permissions and may not be able to inspect private sibling repositories.

### Current connected repositories
The connected GitHub account currently exposes these owned repositories to the corporate registry:
- `nararya-customer-service-platform` (private)
- `modbussid-converter`
- `nararya-bot-discord`
- `narasacakraperwana-website`
- `nararyastudio-website`
- `nararyagarage-website`
- `nexovonarsacorporation-website`

New owned repositories are automatically discovered by the sync job. If a new repository has no corporate mapping, it appears as **UNMAPPED** until its mapping is added to `sync-config.json`.


## Automated quality controls

The **Corporate Quality Gate** runs `scripts/validate.mjs` on pushes and pull requests. The validator checks JavaScript syntax, required files, portfolio fields, duplicate IDs, progress bounds, route coverage, GitHub URL safety, scraper configuration, generated snapshot structure and accidental token-like literals.

The scraper is intentionally metadata-only. It fetches configured public HTTPS pages, records title/description/canonical URL/HTTP status/fetch timing, and never requires credentials or private cookies. A failed public source is reported in the dashboard instead of being silently treated as healthy.

The **System Health** page is an operational view of the latest generated snapshots. It does not invent project progress, PIC, budget or target values; unknown operational values remain **TBD**.


## Authentication and localization

Authentication is implemented with Supabase Auth in the browser. The repository contains a safe placeholder in `config.js`; replace only the Supabase project URL and publishable browser key. Never place a `service_role` credential in browser code.

Google Sign-In requires the Google OAuth client plus Google provider configuration in Supabase. The setup steps are documented in [docs/AUTH_SETUP.md](docs/AUTH_SETUP.md). For GitHub Pages, the deploy workflow can generate the published `config.js` from repository secrets `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`; the source repository keeps only safe placeholders.

The UI provides ten selectable languages and persists the selection locally. Theme, reduced motion and auto-refresh are also user settings. Authentication sessions are persisted by Supabase Auth rather than by storing raw passwords in the application.


## NPM and Gateway Runtime

The repository now has an npm contract for local/server execution:

```bash
npm install
npm test
npm start
```

The frontend remains deployable as a static GitHub Pages site. The optional Node.js gateway serves the same frontend and exposes health/version endpoints for VPS, container or reverse-proxy environments. The project intentionally uses no frontend npm runtime dependencies, so the install step stays deterministic and lightweight.

See [docs/GATEWAY.md](docs/GATEWAY.md) for the gateway runbook.

## Copyright Footer

Website and bot surfaces use the required footer:

**PT. NEXOVONARSACORPORATION - All Right Reserved**

# NEXOVONARSA CORPORATION Gateway

Gateway ini adalah runtime Node.js opsional untuk menjalankan frontend yang sama dengan environment lokal/server.

## Jalankan

```bash
npm install
npm start
```

Default URL:

`http://127.0.0.1:8080`

Environment:

- `HOST` default `127.0.0.1`
- `PORT` default `8080`

## Endpoint

- `GET /api/health` — status gateway dan versi runtime.
- `GET /api/version` — identitas aplikasi dan versi.
- Semua asset frontend tersedia melalui gateway statis.

Gateway menambahkan header keamanan dasar, menolak method selain GET/HEAD, dan memeriksa path agar asset tidak bisa keluar dari root aplikasi.

## Test

```bash
npm test
```

Test mencakup validator repository, smoke test seluruh route frontend, dan smoke test gateway.

GitHub Pages tetap menggunakan deployment statis. Gateway digunakan untuk local development, VPS/container, reverse proxy, atau environment Node.js lain.

# Authentication Setup

The website uses Supabase Auth for email/password registration, password login, password reset and Google OAuth.

## 1. Create a Supabase project

Create a Supabase project and copy the project URL plus the publishable browser key.

For local development, put them only in `config.js`:

```js
window.NX_CONFIG.supabase.url = "https://YOUR-PROJECT.supabase.co";
window.NX_CONFIG.supabase.publishableKey = "YOUR_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY";
```

Never put a Supabase `service_role` key in `config.js`, browser JavaScript or GitHub Pages. The browser integration is intentionally limited to the publishable/anon credential. For the GitHub Pages deployment, add repository secrets named `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`; the deploy workflow injects them only into the generated `gh-pages` artifact.

## 2. Enable email authentication

In Supabase Authentication settings, enable Email.

Users can then register and log in from the account dialog. If email confirmation is enabled, a newly registered user must verify the address before a session is established.

## 3. Enable Google OAuth

In the Google Auth Platform / Google Cloud project, create a Web OAuth client and configure the website origin.

Then enable Google under the Supabase Authentication provider settings and add the application origin/redirect configuration used by the site.

The website sends users through:

```js
supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
  provider: "google",
  options: {
    redirectTo: window.location.origin + window.location.pathname
  }
});
```

For the GitHub Pages deployment, the redirect URL should point to the deployed project path, for example:

```text
https://USERNAME.github.io/REPOSITORY/
```

Also add the local development origin when testing locally.

## 4. Password reset

The login dialog includes password reset. Supabase sends the reset flow back to the same application origin configured in `config.js`.

## 5. Deployment authentication\n\nThe production deployment reads `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` from GitHub Actions repository secrets when both are present. The generated `gh-pages/config.js` keeps the browser publishable key and dynamic `window.location.origin + window.location.pathname` redirect. If the secrets are not configured, deployment intentionally keeps the safe placeholder and authentication remains disabled.\n\n## 6. Settings

The website stores language, theme, reduced-motion and auto-refresh preferences in browser storage. Authentication state is handled by Supabase Auth.

## Supported languages

1. Indonesia
2. English
3. Melayu
4. Tiếng Việt
5. ไทย
6. 简体中文
7. 日本語
8. 한국어
9. العربية
10. Español

# NEXOVONARSA CORPORATION — Commerce, AI & Transaction Platform

**Project ID:** NXC-COMMERCE-2026-001  
**Owner:** PT. NEXOVONARSA CORPORATION  
**Status:** PLANNED — implementation requires backend and payment-provider configuration  
**Planning period:** 2026–2030

## Goal

Define a secure, production-oriented commerce layer for corporate and business-unit services. The existing Corporate Project Control Center is a static dashboard; it must not pretend to process payments or expose secret credentials in browser code.

## User and project identity

- Generate an immutable internal user_id after server-side account creation (UUID/ULID).
- Generate a separate project_id for each managed project and a unique transaction_id for every checkout attempt.
- Store identity and access data server-side. Never use a client-provided ID as proof of identity.
- Support account profile, order history, and audit events with least-privilege access.

## Checkout lifecycle

1. User adds products/services to a cart and changes quantities.
2. Server reloads authoritative prices, checks stock/availability, calculates applicable fees, and creates an order.
3. Server creates a payment session with a licensed QRIS-capable payment provider.
4. Set payment expiry to at least 10 minutes; recommended default is 15 minutes, subject to provider support.
5. Display provider-generated QRIS, amount, transaction ID, expiry countdown, and PENDING status.
6. Mark an order PAID only after verifying the provider's signed webhook/callback and matching transaction, amount, currency, and order reference.
7. Expire unpaid orders server-side and reject late payment attempts according to provider rules.
8. Notify the customer and operators through an approved WhatsApp Business API integration after relevant order/payment state changes.

Never trust a browser button, screenshot, or user-submitted message as payment proof. Do not store payment credentials or provider secrets in frontend files.

## Suggested transaction states

CART → PENDING_PAYMENT → PAID
PENDING_PAYMENT → EXPIRED | CANCELLED | FAILED
PAID → REFUND_PENDING → REFUNDED (only when refund support is implemented)

Every transition should be validated server-side and written to an append-only audit log. Webhooks must be authenticated and idempotent.

## AI assistant

- Provide an assistant for product/service discovery, FAQ, and help with order status.
- Retrieve order details only after server-side authentication and authorization.
- Treat model output as advisory; do not let AI approve payments, alter prices, issue refunds, or access secrets.
- Add rate limits, input/output validation, abuse monitoring, and a fallback when the AI provider is unavailable.

## Real-time updates

Use provider webhooks as the source of truth for payments. Send verified state changes to the UI using Server-Sent Events, WebSockets, or short polling. Existing GitHub metadata sync is near-real-time repository monitoring, not a payment-status source.

## Required integrations and secrets

Configure these in the hosting provider's encrypted environment/secret store, never in committed files:

- Database URL and server-side service credentials
- Authentication provider settings
- QRIS payment provider API credentials and webhook signing secret
- WhatsApp Business API token, phone-number ID, and approved message templates
- AI provider API key, model selection, usage limits, and safety settings
- Public application URL and allowed-origin configuration

Do not enable production checkout until a real payment provider account, webhook endpoint, and end-to-end test transaction are configured.

## Minimum data model

- users: user_id, auth subject, display name, created/updated timestamps
- projects: project_id, owner, name, status, timestamps
- products: product/service ID, title, active flag, server-side price, currency
- orders: order ID, user ID, immutable item/price snapshot, totals, status, expiry
- transactions: transaction ID, order ID, provider reference, amount, status, expiry
- webhook_events: provider event ID, verified flag, processing result, received timestamp
- notifications: recipient, channel, template, delivery status, timestamps
- audit_events: actor, action, entity ID, timestamp, minimal metadata

## Delivery gates

- [ ] Confirm products, prices, currencies, and business-unit ownership.
- [ ] Select a QRIS provider and complete sandbox onboarding.
- [ ] Implement database schema, migrations, and server-side authorization.
- [ ] Implement cart and checkout UI with accessible responsive components.
- [ ] Implement payment-session creation, signed webhook verification, idempotency, and expiry worker.
- [ ] Implement WhatsApp Business notification integration with retry and delivery logs.
- [ ] Implement AI assistant with authorization, rate limits, and usage controls.
- [ ] Add unit, integration, security, and browser tests.
- [ ] Run sandbox end-to-end payment tests including expiry, duplicate webhooks, amount mismatch, and provider outage.
- [ ] Capture actual desktop and mobile screenshots from a running build.
- [ ] Configure production secrets and monitoring before enabling live payments.

## Current implementation boundary

This document records the technical direction. It does not claim that QRIS payments, WhatsApp delivery, AI API calls, or production real-time transaction processing are active. Those require a server-side application, provider accounts, secrets, and end-to-end validation.

# Real-time Commerce & AI — Implementation Status

**Project ID:** NXC-COMMERCE-2026-001  
**Updated:** 2026-10-25  
**Repository:** nexovonarsacorporation-website

## Truthful status

The current `commerce` screen is a front-end demonstration. It is not a live commerce service and must not be presented as accepting real payments.

| Capability | Current state | Required for production |
|---|---|---|
| Product catalogue | Static demo items in browser code | Authoritative catalogue API/database |
| Cart | Browser-local demo state | Server-side cart validation and pricing |
| Transaction ID | Generated by browser demo | Server-generated immutable transaction record |
| Expiry | Browser timer (15 minutes) | Server-side expiry timestamp and scheduled/reconciled status |
| QRIS | Not connected | Licensed payment provider, server-created payment session/QR, verified signed webhook |
| WhatsApp | Not connected | WhatsApp Business Platform credentials, approved templates where required, delivery/error handling |
| AI assistant | Keyword-based demo replies | Server-side model/API integration, secrets stored only in server environment, rate limits and abuse controls |
| Real-time status | No authoritative order feed | Database events/SSE or WebSocket plus periodic reconciliation |
| Authentication | Supabase UI/config placeholder | Configured Supabase project, policies/RLS, identity-bound server checks |
| Audit trail | Demo-only/browser state | Append-only server-side audit events |
| Accuracy | Demo/static values | Source-of-truth database, validation, provider webhook reconciliation and monitoring |

## Production architecture

1. **Static frontend:** renders catalogue, cart, checkout and order status. It never stores provider secrets or AI API keys.
2. **API gateway/backend:** authenticates the user, validates SKU and price against the server catalogue, calculates totals, creates transaction IDs, and enforces state transitions.
3. **Database:** persists users, products, orders, payment attempts, webhook events, expiry timestamps and audit logs. Use migrations and least-privilege access.
4. **Payment provider:** create a QRIS payment session server-side. Store provider reference and expiry. Mark an order paid only after validating the provider's signed webhook or a server-to-server status check. Never trust a browser redirect or screenshot as payment proof.
5. **Expiry/reconciliation worker:** expires unpaid orders using server time and checks uncertain payment states with the provider before finalizing them.
6. **WhatsApp Business:** send order/payment updates from the backend after state changes. Treat delivery as asynchronous; do not claim a message was delivered without provider confirmation.
7. **AI endpoint:** calls the selected model from the server. Give it only necessary order context, redact sensitive data, require authorization before looking up an order, and never let model output directly mark an order paid or issue a refund.
8. **Live updates:** push server-confirmed order changes through SSE/WebSocket where available; retain polling as a fallback. Display the last successful sync time and a stale/offline warning.

## Environment variables (server only)

Configure these in the hosting provider's secret manager, never in Git or static frontend files:

- `DATABASE_URL` or managed database connection settings
- `SUPABASE_URL` and server-side key only if a trusted backend needs it
- `PAYMENT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL`, `PAYMENT_PROVIDER_API_KEY`, `PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET`
- `WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID`, `WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN`
- `AI_API_KEY`, `AI_MODEL`
- `APP_BASE_URL`

Use publishable browser keys only where designed for public use. Never use a service-role key, payment secret, WhatsApp token, or AI key in browser JavaScript or Git commits.

## Order state machine

Allowed state transitions must be enforced by the backend:

- `pending_payment -> paid` only after verified provider confirmation
- `pending_payment -> expired` only after server expiry and reconciliation
- `pending_payment -> cancelled` only after an authorized cancellation
- `paid -> fulfilled` only after fulfillment confirmation
- `paid -> refund_pending -> refunded` only through an authorized refund workflow

Duplicate webhook delivery must be idempotent. Store provider event IDs and reject invalid signatures. If payment status is ambiguous, show `verification_pending` rather than guessing.

## Definition of done

- [ ] Production API and database deployed and health-checked
- [ ] Catalogue, cart and totals validated server-side
- [ ] Authentication, authorization and database access policies tested
- [ ] Real QRIS sandbox test passes, including invalid signature, duplicate webhook, delayed webhook, failed and expired payment
- [ ] WhatsApp sandbox/test message confirmed by provider callback
- [ ] AI endpoint uses a real model with server-only credentials, timeouts, rate limits and safe fallback
- [ ] Live order updates tested with reconnect and stale-data indicator
- [ ] Automated unit/integration tests and CI pass
- [ ] Secrets and personal data are absent from repository, logs and client bundles
- [ ] Production domain, monitoring, backup and incident procedure configured

## Accuracy commitment

“100% accurate” and “real-time” cannot be honestly guaranteed for every external service. The product should expose source, timestamp, sync health and uncertainty, and should never invent a live status. The current demo is not production-ready until the checklist above is completed and verified.

## Current blockers

This repository change alone cannot provision payment-provider merchant access, WhatsApp Business credentials, a live AI key, a database, or production hosting secrets. These must be configured in the relevant provider dashboards and deployment environment before the integration can be tested end-to-end.

# Nexovonarsa SuperApp

Responsive web MVP for learning, entertainment discovery, games, security education, productivity, and a digital service store.

## Current implementation

- **Home portal** (`index.html`): responsive portal with feature search and categories.
- **Store prototype** (`store.html`): searchable catalog, browser-side cart, checkout demo, demo transaction ID, 10-minute browser countdown, WhatsApp deep link, and AI assistant placeholder.
- **Developer & Security Lab** (`developer-tools.html`): bug-report builder with TXT export, JSON validator, text inspector, demo ID generator, and manual WhatsApp compatibility and device-privacy checklists.
- **Status page** (`status.html`): polls the public GitHub Actions API every 60 seconds to show recent workflow runs. This reflects workflow state, not full production uptime.
- **Automated checks**: GitHub Actions runs the static-site checker and Playwright browser tests on pushes to `main` and pull requests targeting `main`; screenshot artifacts are uploaded by CI.

## Real-time data integration plan

The ten-scraper architecture, source authorization rules, freshness/provenance contract, and production release checklist are documented in [`docs/REALTIME_DATA_10_SCRAPERS.md`](docs/REALTIME_DATA_10_SCRAPERS.md). The ten entries are adapter roles, **not live sources already connected**. The static site alone cannot provide secure server-side scraping or live AI.

## Important limitations

This is a static web prototype, not a production-ready service.

- **AI:** no live AI provider is connected. The assistant content is demo text. Real AI needs a secured server-side integration and a provider API key stored as a secret. Never put private API keys in browser JavaScript.
- **Payments:** QRIS is a visual placeholder. No money is collected or verified. Real payments require a payment provider, server-side order records, signature-verified webhooks, and server-side expiry checks.
- **WhatsApp:** the checkout creates a browser deep link only. It does not send automated messages or independently confirm payment.
- **Data:** there is no backend, account system, persistent database, or connected live domain-specific data API. Browser-local notes remain in the current browser.
- **Phone checks:** phone-number validation checks format only; it does not identify an owner or verify WhatsApp registration. Privacy checklists are manual guidance, not device scans.

Do not describe demo data as real-time or verified production data.

## Feature catalog

### Learning
- Qur'an reading module: planned; requires a verified and properly licensed source.
- Shalawat audio player: planned; use authorized audio.
- Study hub and learning checklist: demo.

### Entertainment
- Comic discovery and official provider links: planned.
- Anime, film, music, and podcast discovery through licensed services: planned.
- Mini-game / HTML5 game area: planned.

### Communication

# APKForge AI

APKForge AI is a browser-based workbench for inspecting Android package archives and planning authorized modifications to apps and game assets you own or have permission to edit.

## Implemented workflow

- Responsive Indonesian web dashboard.
- Upload `.apk`, `.apks`, `.aab`, `.obb`, `.zip`, `.apfproj`, `.exe`, and `.msi` for safe storage. EXE/MSI files are never executed by the server.
- ZIP-compatible archive listing without extracting the archive. Preview safety caps: 5,000 entries and 2 GiB total declared uncompressed size.
- APK decode into a workspace using Apktool, when Apktool and Java are installed on the host.
- Project file listing and editing for selected text formats (XML, JSON, text, properties, Smali, HTML, JS, CSS, Java/Kotlin, YAML and config files), limited to 2 MiB per file.
- Rebuild decoded projects into an **unsigned APK** using Apktool.
- Optional APK signing and signature verification using a keystore configured on the server.
- AI change-plan endpoint compatible with chat-completions style providers.
- AI patch proposals across up to five selected editable text files, with per-file review/editing, path/content validation, assumptions, risks, suggested tests, backups and a review step before the user explicitly applies the proposal.
- Persistent local learning memory: stores sanitized request patterns and only reuses patterns from edits the user explicitly approved; similar future requests can use these examples to infer intent with fewer clarification questions. This is retrieval-based memory, not model fine-tuning.
- Allowlisted process helper for Apktool, JADX, and apksigner.
- Asset Manager for replacing supported image, texture, model, audio and data assets, with backup/undo.
- Backup/undo for text file edits and binary asset replacement.
- Windows desktop packaging configured for `.exe` and `.msi` installers through Electron Builder.
- Capacitor Android shell and GitHub Actions workflow configured to build a debug `.apk`.
- GitHub Actions syntax validation.

## Run locally

Requirements: Node.js 20+, Java runtime, and Apktool for decode/build features.

```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env
npm run check
npm run dev
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8787`. On Windows, use `copy .env.example .env` if `cp` is unavailable.

Set `AI_BASE_URL`, `AI_API_KEY`, and `AI_MODEL` in `.env` for an OpenAI-compatible provider. Never commit API keys.

## API

- `GET /api/health` — service status.
- `GET /api/formats` — supported formats and limitations.
- `POST /api/uploads` — upload one file as multipart field `file`.
- `GET /api/uploads/:id/inspect` — preview entries of ZIP-compatible uploads.
- `POST /api/uploads/:id/decode` — decode an uploaded APK with Apktool.
- `GET /api/projects/:id/files` — list decoded project files.
- `GET /api/projects/:id/file?path=...` — read an editable text file.
- `PUT /api/projects/:id/file` — JSON body: `{ "path": "res/values/strings.xml", "content": "..." }`.
- `POST /api/projects/:id/build` — build unsigned APK.
- `GET /api/projects/:id/artifact` — download generated unsigned APK.
- `POST /api/projects/:id/sign` — sign the generated APK using server-configured keystore credentials and verify the signature.
- `GET /api/projects/:id/signed-artifact` — download the signed APK.
- `POST /api/ai/plan` — generate a change plan from JSON `{ "request": "..." }`.
- `POST /api/projects/:id/undo` — restore the latest backup of a text file.
- `PUT /api/projects/:id/asset` — replace a supported binary asset with multipart fields `path` and `file`.
- `POST /api/projects/:id/asset/undo` — restore the latest asset backup.
- `POST /api/projects/:id/ai/patch-plan` — propose a reviewable text-file edit from JSON `{ "request": "...", "paths": ["res/values/strings.xml"] }`. The AI can only propose edits to the selected editable files; the proposal is not applied until the user reviews it and explicitly confirms. Relevant user-approved patterns may be supplied as context.
- `POST /api/projects/:id/ai/apply-patch` — apply 1–5 reviewed file changes with validation and backups.
- `POST /api/ai/learn` — record an explicitly approved request pattern after an AI-proposed edit has been applied. The server stores sanitized request/summary/file-type metadata, not source-file contents.

## Current limitations (read before production)

This is a functional development workflow, **not a completed universal APK modder**. Decode/build depends on the host having Apktool and Java installed. Rebuilt output is unsigned until the optional signing workflow is configured with a keystore you control. Never commit keystores or passwords. The project editor edits text files only; it does not automatically replace 3D models, textures, vehicle assets, or arbitrary binary resources. The AI planner creates plans, and the patch endpoint proposes edits to selected text files. A proposal requires manual review and explicit confirmation before it is saved. Approved request patterns are kept in the server workspace and retrieved for similar future requests; this does not train or fine-tune the underlying model, and memory is local to that server/workspace. The AI still cannot implement features whose required source files, APIs, engine hooks, or binary-format specifications are not available. Asset replacement is format-agnostic at the file level and cannot guarantee game-specific model/texture compatibility.

The project can be packaged as its own Windows `.exe` installer and `.msi` installer, and as an Android debug `.apk`. These are APKForge AI app builds, not automatic conversion of an uploaded APK into Windows binaries. An APK cannot be directly converted into a native Windows EXE. The Android APK bundles the dashboard UI; the processing API must be hosted on a reachable HTTPS server and configured in the app. OBB files may be proprietary, encrypted, or game-specific; generic archive preview cannot interpret all OBB data.

Before exposing the service to the internet, add authentication, per-user project isolation, rate limits, quotas, malware scanning, background job queue, and a hardened container/sandbox for Android tooling. Set an explicit upload cap for public deployments. `MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES=0` disables only the app-level cap; disk, proxy and host limits remain.

Use only software and assets you are authorized to modify. Do not use this project to bypass DRM, licensing, anti-cheat, or access controls. Never execute uploaded binaries on the server.

## Desktop and Android packages

See [`docs/INSTALLERS.md`](docs/INSTALLERS.md). Run the `Build APKForge AI installers` workflow from GitHub Actions to generate Windows `.exe`/`.msi` installers and an Android debug `.apk`. The workflow has been configured in the repository, but build artifacts exist only after a successful workflow run. The Android package requires a separately hosted HTTPS API for processing features.

# Desktop and Android builds

APKForge AI has a Windows desktop shell and a Capacitor Android shell.

## Windows

Run `npm install`, then `npm run desktop:win` on Windows. Electron Builder produces a Windows installer executable (`.exe`) and a native Windows Installer package (`.msi`) under `release/`. The build script generates a small ICO resource before packaging so the MSI target can resolve its application icon.

The desktop shell starts the local Node/Express API. Android tooling such as Java and Apktool must still be installed separately for APK decode/rebuild features.

## Android

The GitHub Actions workflow creates a **debug APK** at `android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`. Download it from the workflow's Artifacts section. This is not a Play Store-signed release.

The APK bundles the dashboard UI, while the processing API remains a server component. Host the API on a reachable HTTPS server, open APKForge AI's API connection settings, enter the server base URL (without a trailing slash), save it, and test the connection. Configure CORS on the server to allow the app origin when required. Do not put AI keys or signing secrets in the Android client.

## Automated builds

- Run the “Build APKForge AI installers” workflow manually from Actions, or push a version tag such as `v0.2.0`.
- Download `apkforge-ai-windows-installers` for `.exe` and `.msi`.
- Download `apkforge-ai-android-debug-apk` for `.apk`.

The workflow has been committed as configuration; artifacts are only available after the workflow successfully runs. A successful package build does not replace real-device and Windows installation tests.
## APK signing for projects edited in the workbench

To enable the **Sign & verify APK** button, install Android Build Tools containing `apksigner` on the server and set these values in the server's private `.env`:

- `APKFORGE_KEYSTORE_PATH`: path to a keystore file stored securely on the server.
- `APKFORGE_KEY_ALIAS`: alias of the signing key.
- `APKFORGE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`: keystore password.
- `APKFORGE_KEY_PASSWORD`: private-key password.

Never commit the keystore or these values. Signing keys must remain under your control. The app verifies the signature after signing, but you must still test the resulting APK on a device.

# APKForge AI — Remaining Work and Release Checklist

This checklist separates features that currently work in the development workflow from work that must not be treated as complete merely because CI produced installers.

## Verified in CI
- Source syntax checks and automated unit tests run before Windows and Android packaging.
- Windows NSIS `.exe` and `.msi` installers are produced as workflow artifacts.
- A debug Android `.apk` is produced as a workflow artifact.
- Desktop and mobile dashboard screenshots are captured in CI.
- Windows packaging uses `--publish never`; artifacts are uploaded by Actions instead of requiring a GitHub release token.

## Priority 0 — Before exposing the API publicly
- [ ] Add per-user authentication/authorization to every project, upload, build, signing, AI, and undo endpoint, with workspace isolation.
- [x] Add optional shared bearer-token protection for single-operator API deployments; production API requests fail closed when `API_AUTH_TOKEN` is missing. This is only a baseline, not per-user authorization.
- [ ] Enforce per-user workspace isolation; never let one user access another user's upload, project, backups, or artifacts.
- [x] Enforce a default 100 MiB upload-size cap in the API; operators can override it with `MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES`.
- [x] Add configurable per-process API rate limiting (default 120 requests per 60 seconds per IP; `/api/health` excluded) and apply the configured upload cap to asset uploads.
- [ ] Configure a shared/distributed limiter and request rate limits at the reverse proxy before multi-instance/public deployment.
- [ ] Run Android tooling in a disposable, resource-limited sandbox with network access disabled where possible.
- [ ] Keep API keys and keystore credentials in a secret manager/environment, never in source control or client-side code.
- [ ] Add malware scanning, retention/cleanup policies, audit logs, and quotas before accepting untrusted public uploads.

## Priority 1 — Editing and build reliability
- [ ] Add integration tests using a small, redistributable sample APK and verify decode → edit → rebuild behavior on a host with Java and Apktool.
- [ ] Test signing and signature verification with a temporary test keystore in CI; do not ship that key.
- [ ] Validate output APK installation and launch on an emulator or physical device.
- [ ] Add background jobs, progress reporting, cancellation, and safe cleanup for long-running decode/build tasks.
- [ ] Add fixture-based tests for archive bombs, malformed ZIPs, symlinks, path traversal, oversized assets, and invalid project identifiers.
- [ ] Add dependency audit and license review as a separate release gate; triage findings rather than blindly applying breaking upgrades.

## Priority 2 — Feature completeness
- [ ] Add format-specific adapters for supported texture/model/audio formats and validate each with known fixtures. A generic file replacement is not proof of game-engine compatibility.
- [ ] Improve APK/OBB inspection with clear per-format support and explicit encrypted/proprietary-format errors.
- [ ] Add diff preview, staged patch validation, transactional multi-file apply, and rollback tests for AI proposals.
- [x] Add configurable AI provider timeouts (`AI_TIMEOUT_MS`, default 60 seconds, clamped to 1–180 seconds), bounded provider JSON response size (`AI_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES`, default 1 MiB, clamped to 1 KiB–8 MiB) across both AI flows, strict legacy planner response validation, and project patch proposal structure/allowed-path validation.
- [ ] Add broader AI provider contract tests and user-visible AI error-state verification.
- [ ] Add platform-specific testing for Windows installers and the Android shell on real devices.

## AI provider configuration
- `AI_TIMEOUT_MS` sets the AI provider request timeout in milliseconds (default `60000`, clamped to `1000`–`180000`).
- `AI_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES` sets the maximum buffered AI provider JSON response (default `1048576`, clamped to `1024`–`8388608`). Oversized or invalid JSON responses are rejected.
- These controls harden provider calls but do not configure or deploy an AI provider. Real-time AI availability still depends on valid server-side `AI_BASE_URL`, `AI_API_KEY`, `AI_MODEL`, network access, and provider uptime.

## Rate-limit configuration
- `API_AUTH_TOKEN` enables shared `Authorization: Bearer <token>` protection for `/api/*` except `/api/health`. In `NODE_ENV=production`, API requests fail with `503` when the token is unset. Use a long random secret and keep it server-side; this is not a substitute for per-user identities, authorization, or workspace isolation.
- `.env.example` now uses `MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES=104857600` (100 MiB) to match the API's default cap; `0` would unintentionally set a zero-byte limit.
- `API_RATE_MAX` sets the allowed requests per IP per window (default `120`).
- `API_RATE_WINDOW_MS` sets the window length in milliseconds (default `60000`).
- The in-memory limiter is per process and is not a substitute for a shared store or reverse-proxy protection on a public, multi-instance deployment. Avoid enabling `trust proxy` unless the proxy chain is explicitly configured.

## Important limitations
- The generated Android package is a dashboard shell. Processing features require a separately hosted, reachable HTTPS API.
- Rebuilt APKs are unsigned unless signing is configured with a keystore controlled by the operator.
- APKs are not converted directly into native Windows executables. A Windows build requires a compatible runtime or a separate port/rebuild.
- AI suggestions are proposals, not proof that code or assets are correct. Review diffs and run tests before accepting them.
- CI success confirms the configured checks and packaging steps passed; it does not prove universal compatibility or production security.

## Release acceptance
A release should be called production-ready only after the relevant unchecked security, integration, device, and compatibility checks have been completed and their results recorded. Do not mark unchecked items complete based only on successful packaging.

- 🇬🇧 English
- 🇲🇾 Bahasa Melayu
- 🇨🇳 简体中文
- 🇯🇵 日本語
- 🇰🇷 한국어
- 🇸🇦 العربية
- 🇪🇸 Español
- 🇫🇷 Français
- 🇩🇪 Deutsch

Local account:
- Register
- Login
- Logout
- Password hash with bcrypt
- JWT session

Google:

- Google-only users can create a local password later in Settings

Google OAuth redirect URIs:


- HTML/CSS selector
- RSS/XML
- JSON

- HTTPS only
- response timeout
- response size limit
- configurable HTTPS host allowlist; every redirect target is re-validated
- maximum 10 configured sources, unique source keys, bounded timeout/response size
- extracted item/image links are stored only when they resolve to HTTPS URLs without embedded credentials
- each source records its own success/error state so a failed source does not stop later configured sources
- database persistence
- run history
- dry-run configuration validation

Commands:

```bash
npm run scrape
npm run scrape:check
```

Scheduler endpoint:

`/api/scraper/run`

Public website:
- public repository metadata
- commit information when authenticated

```bash
npm run db:seed
npm run check
npm run dev
```

Set `PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET` to a unique random secret of at least 32 characters. # Nararya Groub Strobo Generator Website

Website tools berbasis HTML, CSS, dan JavaScript murni. Tidak membutuhkan framework atau proses build.

## Fitur
- **Strobo Generator:** pola alternate, full screen, quad, pulse, dan split; warna A/B; kecepatan; kecerahan; ukuran panel; glow; label.
- **Image Motion Studio:** unggah PNG/JPG/WebP; preset Zoom In/Out, Pan, Rotasi, Floating, Shake, Fade, dan Ken Burns; pengaturan animasi manual bergaya keyframe (zoom awal/akhir, posisi X/Y, rotasi), transisi masuk/keluar (fade, zoom, slide, rotate), durasi, intensitas, cover/contain, latar, FPS, timeline, ekspor PNG dan WebM.\n- **Running Text Generator:** teks kustom, warna teks/latar/glow, kecepatan, ukuran dan ketebalan font, gaya LED glow/outline/solid/rainbow, bingkai.
- Pengaturan tersimpan otomatis di browser saat kontrol berubah; proyek juga bisa diekspor/impor sebagai JSON.
- Ukuran canvas kustom, preset rasio, ekspor batch PNG, dan mode terang/gelap.
- Asisten prompt lokal berbasis aturan untuk menerapkan preset animasi. Ini bukan model AI generatif dan tidak mengklaim data cloud real-time.
- Preview canvas secara langsung.
- Ekspor preview menjadi PNG.
- Rekam animasi menjadi WebM di browser yang mendukung Canvas Capture Stream dan MediaRecorder.
- Responsive untuk HP dan desktop.

## Struktur
```
.
├── index.html
├── strobo.html
├── running-text.html
├── image-motion.html
├── assets/
│   ├── style.css
│   ├── strobo.js
│   └── running-text.js
└── README.md
```

## Menjalankan lokal
Buka `index.html` di browser. Untuk pengalaman terbaik, jalankan lewat GitHub Pages atau server statis sederhana.

## GitHub Pages
Di repository, buka **Settings → Pages**, pilih **Deploy from a branch**, branch `main`, folder `/ (root)`, lalu simpan. Setelah proses deployment selesai, website dapat dibuka lewat URL GitHub Pages yang ditampilkan di halaman tersebut.

## Batasan yang perlu diketahui
- Website saat ini statis dan berjalan di browser. Belum ada backend/database, layanan AI generatif, pembayaran QRIS sungguhan, verifikasi pembayaran, atau konfirmasi WhatsApp.
- Autosave hanya tersimpan di browser/perangkat yang digunakan; tidak disinkronkan lintas perangkat.
- Perubahan kode masuk ke repository melalui commit GitHub; workflow otomatis menguji perubahan setelah push, tetapi tidak menciptakan fitur baru sendiri.

## Catatan keselamatan
Efek strobo berkedip cepat dapat memicu ketidaknyamanan atau kejang pada orang yang sensitif terhadap cahaya. Jangan gunakan efek ini untuk mengganggu pengguna jalan atau pengendara.

© 2026 Nararya Groub. All rights reserved.


## Build dan pemeriksaan browser
- Repository ini adalah website statis, jadi tidak memerlukan proses kompilasi aplikasi.
- GitHub Actions menjalankan smoke test browser pada setiap push ke `main`, pull request ke `main`, dan dapat dijalankan manual dari tab **Actions**.
- Jika tes berhasil, screenshot desktop dan mobile tersedia sebagai artifact bernama `nararya-visual-test-screenshots` pada workflow run.
- Buka **Actions → Build and Visual Smoke Test → run terbaru → Artifacts** untuk mengunduh screenshot hasil tes.


## Otomasi, verifikasi, dan integrasi data

- GitHub Actions menjalankan pengujian browser saat ada push ke `main`, pull request, atau pemicu manual. Hasil sukses/gagal terlihat pada tab **Actions**; workflow tidak membuat fitur baru secara mandiri.
- Tes browser memeriksa homepage, generator strobo, running text, Image Motion Studio, kontrol animasi, autosave lokal, manifest PWA, ikon aplikasi, dan registrasi service worker. Screenshot tes diunggah sebagai artifact bila dihasilkan.
- **Scraper tidak dipasang secara membabi buta.** Generator strobo, running text, dan animasi gambar bekerja dari input pengguna di browser, sehingga tidak membutuhkan data eksternal/API. Mengambil data dari 10 situs tanpa kebutuhan sumber yang jelas tidak meningkatkan akurasi fitur ini.
- Jika kelak ada fitur yang benar-benar membutuhkan data eksternal, gunakan adapter sumber yang terpisah, timeout, validasi skema, cache dengan waktu pembaruan, batas percobaan, pencatatan sumber, dan fallback ke sumber lain. Sepuluh adapter hanya masuk akal jika ada sepuluh sumber relevan yang diizinkan dan dapat diuji.
- **Fallback bukan berarti mengganti scraper dengan AI secara otomatis.** Model AI harus dikonfigurasi melalui backend/proxy yang aman dengan API key tersimpan sebagai GitHub Actions secret atau secret penyedia hosting. Jangan menaruh API key di HTML/JavaScript publik. Hasil AI perlu ditandai sebagai hasil model, bukan data terverifikasi.
- Data real-time dan akurasi 100% tidak dapat dijamin secara universal. Status sumber, timestamp, validasi, dan kegagalan koneksi harus ditampilkan secara jujur. Saat ini aplikasi tidak memiliki backend, API eksternal, scraper aktif, atau layanan AI generatif.

```
│   ├── strobo.js
│   └── running-text.js
└── README.md
```

## Menjalankan lokal
Buka `index.html` di browser. Untuk pengalaman terbaik, jalankan lewat GitHub Pages atau server statis sederhana.

## GitHub Pages
Di repository, buka **Settings → Pages**, pilih **Deploy from a branch**, branch `main`, folder `/ (root)`, lalu simpan. Setelah proses deployment selesai, website dapat dibuka lewat URL GitHub Pages yang ditampilkan di halaman tersebut.

## Batasan yang perlu diketahui
- Website saat ini statis dan berjalan di browser. Belum ada backend/database, layanan AI generatif, pembayaran QRIS sungguhan, verifikasi pembayaran, atau konfirmasi WhatsApp.
- Autosave hanya tersimpan di browser/perangkat yang digunakan; tidak disinkronkan lintas perangkat.
- Perubahan kode masuk ke repository melalui commit GitHub; workflow otomatis menguji perubahan setelah push, tetapi tidak menciptakan fitur baru sendiri.

## Catatan keselamatan
Efek strobo berkedip cepat dapat memicu ketidaknyamanan atau kejang pada orang yang sensitif terhadap cahaya. Jangan gunakan efek ini untuk mengganggu pengguna jalan atau pengendara.

© 2026 Nararya Groub. All rights reserved.


## Build dan pemeriksaan browser
- Repository ini adalah website statis, jadi tidak memerlukan proses kompilasi aplikasi.
- GitHub Actions menjalankan smoke test browser pada setiap push ke `main`, pull request ke `main`, dan dapat dijalankan manual dari tab **Actions**.
- Jika tes berhasil, screenshot desktop dan mobile tersedia sebagai artifact bernama `nararya-visual-test-screenshots` pada workflow run.
- Buka **Actions → Build and Visual Smoke Test → run terbaru → Artifacts** untuk mengunduh screenshot hasil tes.


## Otomasi, verifikasi, dan integrasi data

- GitHub Actions menjalankan pengujian browser saat ada push ke `main`, pull request, atau pemicu manual. Hasil sukses/gagal terlihat pada tab **Actions**; workflow tidak membuat fitur baru secara mandiri.
- Tes browser memeriksa homepage, generator strobo, running text, Image Motion Studio, kontrol animasi, autosave lokal, manifest PWA, ikon aplikasi, dan registrasi service worker. Screenshot tes diunggah sebagai artifact bila dihasilkan.
- **Scraper tidak dipasang secara membabi buta.** Generator strobo, running text, dan animasi gambar bekerja dari input pengguna di browser, sehingga tidak membutuhkan data eksternal/API. Mengambil data dari 10 situs tanpa kebutuhan sumber yang jelas tidak meningkatkan akurasi fitur ini.
- Jika kelak ada fitur yang benar-benar membutuhkan data eksternal, gunakan adapter sumber yang terpisah, timeout, validasi skema, cache dengan waktu pembaruan, batas percobaan, pencatatan sumber, dan fallback ke sumber lain. Sepuluh adapter hanya masuk akal jika ada sepuluh sumber relevan yang diizinkan dan dapat diuji.
- **Fallback bukan berarti mengganti scraper dengan AI secara otomatis.** Model AI harus dikonfigurasi melalui backend/proxy yang aman dengan API key tersimpan sebagai GitHub Actions secret atau secret penyedia hosting. Jangan menaruh API key di HTML/JavaScript publik. Hasil AI perlu ditandai sebagai hasil model, bukan data terverifikasi.
- Data real-time dan akurasi 100% tidak dapat dijamin secara universal. Status sumber, timestamp, validasi, dan kegagalan koneksi harus ditampilkan secara jujur. Saat ini aplikasi tidak memiliki backend, API eksternal, scraper aktif, atau layanan AI generatif.

# Nararya Bot Discord

Nararya Bot Discord adalah bot Discord modular untuk komunitas, JKT48, game, data Indonesia, notifikasi, media processing, moderation, verification, dan developer operations.

## Current release

Version: 3.2.2
Release date: 2026-09-20

The 3.2.0 web runtime adds a modular gateway, versioned API routes, responsive device detection, local registration/login, secure sessions, Google OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, account settings, theme preferences, timezone preferences, and ten selectable interface languages.
Active feature registry: 150 features

## Core capabilities

- JKT48 member database generations 1-14, upcoming and latest information, platform feeds, live monitoring, quiz, gacha, card collection, and EXP profile card.
- General Google Street View quiz. Fitur ini adalah game lokasi dan tidak berfokus pada JKT48.
- Indonesia news, stock quotes, fuel prices, electricity tariffs, food prices, Ramadan schedules, dan disaster monitoring.
- Restaurant menu and price aggregation melalui sumber publik MenuKuliner.net.
- Media download dan processing melalui yt-dlp, FFmpeg, Demucs, dan rembg jika dependency terkait tersedia.
- Web verification dengan server-bound one-time codes.
- Owner-only setup, global bot settings, server blacklist, user blacklist, security controls, dan audit tooling.
- Scraper registry and database audit pipeline with URL checks every 10 seconds.
- Leveling dengan visual EXP profile card.
- Rotating Discord Playing status.

## Project structure

~~~
src/
 config/
 commands/
 jkt48/
 media/
 music/
 security/
 services/
 tools/
 web/
 index.js
 deploy-commands.js

tools/
 media/

test/
docs/
website/
~~~

## Installation

1. Copy .env.example to .env.
2. Configure DISCORD_TOKEN, CLIENT_ID, database paths, dan optional service credentials.
3. Install Node dependencies with npm install.
4. Install optional system dependencies for media processing:
 - FFmpeg
 - yt-dlp
 - Python
 - Python packages from tools/media/requirements.txt
 - Demucs for vocal separation
5. Deploy slash commands with npm run deploy.
6. Start the full Discord + website runtime with npm start. The website is served from the same Node process.
7. For Google Login, configure GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, and GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI. The redirect URI must match the Google OAuth client configuration exactly.
8. GitHub Pages/static hosting can serve the public frontend, but cannot execute the Node authentication endpoints. Use the Node website runtime for login, register, settings, verification, and Google OAuth.

## Verification

Use /verify start to create a server-bound verification session. The bot returns a private website URL. The website validates the session, performs the "I'm not a robot" interaction, and returns a temporary four-character code. The user submits the code with /verify code.

The code is derived from a per-server secret and the current session identifier.

## Media

The media subsystem provides:

- Video download with selectable resolution and format.
- Audio download for public media URLs.
- Image download from direct image URLs, Open Graph image metadata, or supported yt-dlp sources.
- Vocal removal and instrumental generation.
- Background removal for images and videos.
- Watermark removal for images and videos using an explicitly provided rectangle.
- Per-user default media resolution and format settings.

## Data and scraper policy

External non-JKT48 data must have a source contract and scraper or API adapter. JKT48 sources use the configured repository or source URLs and remain exempt from the generic scraper requirement.

The data audit pipeline:

1. Checks database contents.
2. Finds URL fields.
3. Checks URL health.
4. Matches URLs against the scraper registry.
5. Detects missing or unhealthy adapters.
6. Stores findings.
7. Reports suggested scraper methods for unresolved URLs.

The scraper pipeline runs every 10 seconds and exposes live health status through the website gateway.

Indonesia source caches use a 24-hour refresh policy unless a source-specific policy requires a shorter interval.

## JKT48 integration references

The JKT48 subsystem uses adapter-based integrations inspired by the public architecture of the following repositories. Code is not vendored wholesale. Each integration is implemented behind Nararya Bot interfaces and must respect the upstream repository license and the target platform terms.

- sendyarf/jkt48-archiver: IDN HLS health-check, recording-state, reconnect, and archive pipeline concepts.
- ayouree/jkt48showroom-api: SHOWROOM data integration concepts.
- ojixzzz/twitterbot48: JKT48 X/Twitter notification concepts.
- pranendraa/piobot-live: multi-platform live notification concepts for SHOWROOM, IDN Live, and TikTok.
- FrenzY8/JKT48Guessr: quiz and guessing-game concepts.
- crstlnz/jkt48showroom-api: SHOWROOM API concepts.
- FrenzY8/JKT48Member: historical and active member data source.
- Synxx12/idn-api-live-jkt48: IDN Live data integration concepts.
- faruuhan/scraping-jkt48-website: JKT48 website scraping concepts.

The generation 14 seed is based on the JKT48 official announcement dated 18 May 2026 and is merged with the historical member source during synchronization.

## Security

Secrets must be stored in environment variables and never committed to the repository. See SECURITY.md for reporting and operational guidance.

The bot includes owner controls, maintenance mode, blacklists, verification sessions, rate limiting, security incidents, moderation case IDs, and scraper audit logging.

## Development

Run the test suite with:

~~~
npm test
~~~

Run JavaScript syntax validation locally:

~~~
find src test -type f -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
~~~

## Documentation

- CHANGELOG.md
- VERSION.md
- SECURITY.md
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- docs/COMMANDS.md
- docs/FEATURE-REGISTRY.md
- docs/INDONESIA-DATA.md
- docs/JKT48-SOURCES.md
- docs/JKT48-INTEGRATION-NOTES.md
- docs/JKT48-CONNECT.md
- docs/MEDIA.md
- docs/NOTIFICATION-SOURCES.md
- docs/SCRAPER-MATRIX.md
- docs/STRUCTURE.md
- docs/VERIFICATION.md


## Website

The website at `website/jkt48/` is responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Full runtime features:
- Login and registration.
- Google OAuth 2.0 with PKCE.
- Secure HTTP-only session cookies.
- Language selection: Indonesian, English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Arabic, Spanish, Portuguese, French, and German.
- Light, dark, and system themes.
- Timezone settings.
- Password change.
- JKT48 member database and source status.
- Live scraper health status.

Run the full runtime with `npm start`. The Node website server uses `WEBSITE_HOST`, `WEBSITE_PORT`, and `WEBSITE_PUBLIC_URL`.

Static hosting is still supported for the read-only frontend. Authentication and OAuth require the backend runtime.

# Game Mod Asset Lab v5.0.0

Game Mod Asset Lab adalah aplikasi web untuk inspeksi, klasifikasi, packaging, export, scraper publik, dan pengelolaan asset yang memang dimiliki atau memang boleh diproses oleh pengguna.

## Struktur v5

| Folder | Deskripsi |
|---|---|
| `backend/` | FastAPI application, API routes, gateway, auth, catalog, scraper, dan asset API. |
| `frontend/` | HTML, vanilla JavaScript, CSS responsive, PWA manifest, service worker, dan icon. |
| `core/` | Logic inti yang dipakai bersama backend, tooling, tests, dan adapter platform. |
| `platforms/` | Adapter BUSSID, ETS2/ATS, dan Roblox. |
| `assets/` | Template dan input asset project-level. |
| `artifacts/` | Output runtime seperti generated export dan download artifact. |
| `tooling/` | Scraper CLI, smoke test, frontend smoke, repository audit, dan check pipeline. |
| `tests/` | Test otomatis backend, auth, exporter, image, scraper, dan UI. |
| `docs/` | Dokumentasi arsitektur, deskripsi folder, dan migrasi v5. |

## Fitur aktif

- Asset inspector dengan SHA-256 dan ZIP/TAR inspection.
- Selective export dan manifest JSON.
- Template classifier AO, Texture, dan Kaca/XOR.
- Sprite Sheet inspect dan frame extraction.
- Strobo, Rotator, dan LED Bar animation package.
- Public Roblox Asset Delivery melalui endpoint resmi.
- Register, login, logout, logout-all, profile, settings, dan password change.
- Google Login melalui OpenID Connect jika credential dikonfigurasi.
- 10 bahasa.
- Responsive mobile, tablet, desktop, dan PWA.
- Repository catalog, tree, dan folder description endpoint.
- Public web scraper dengan anti-SSRF dan same-host crawl.

## Website

Frontend utama:

    frontend/index.html
    frontend/app.js
    frontend/styles.css

Backend entrypoint:

    backend/app.py

Footer resmi:

**PT. NARARYA JAYA UTAMA GROUB - All Right Reserved**

## API utama

    GET /api/health
    GET /api/gateway/health
    GET /api/gateway/routes
    GET /api/repository
    GET /api/repository/tree?prefix=...
    GET /api/repository/folders
    GET /api/project/status
    POST /api/project/assistant

Authentication:

    GET /api/auth/status
    POST /api/auth/register
    POST /api/auth/login
    POST /api/auth/logout
    POST /api/auth/logout-all
    PUT /api/auth/settings
    PUT /api/auth/profile
    PUT /api/auth/password

Scraper:

    GET /api/scraper/fetch?url=...
    GET /api/scraper/crawl?url=...&max_pages=...

## Project ID dan asisten bawaan

- Project ID: `GML-2026-0001`.
- `GET /api/project/status` mengembalikan versi, status, fitur, dan timestamp UTC saat request diproses.
- `POST /api/project/assistant` menerima JSON `{"message":"cara memperbaiki error"}` dan memberi panduan berbasis aturan.
- Endpoint asisten mendukung AI generatif melalui OpenAI Chat Completions jika `OPENAI_API_KEY` disetel sebagai environment/secret server. `OPENAI_MODEL` opsional, default `gpt-4o-mini`. Tanpa API key atau jika provider gagal, API kembali ke aturan bawaan. Status provider dibaca dinamis dari konfigurasi server; jawaban real-time bergantung pada koneksi internet, ketersediaan provider, dan kuota API.
- Konfigurasi server: `OPENAI_API_KEY=<secret>` dan opsional `OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini`. Jangan menaruh key di frontend, file `.env` yang di-commit, atau log. Provider timeout 12 detik dan error provider tidak dibocorkan ke client.

## Scraper CLI

    python tooling/scraper.py https://example.com
    python tooling/scraper.py https://example.com --crawl --max-pages 5
    python tooling/scraper.py https://example.com --output reports/example.json

Scraper hanya ditujukan untuk resource publik dan tidak melewati login, paywall, private resource, DRM, atau access control.

## Instalasi

    npm install
    npm run check
    npm start

Python validation:

    python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
    python tooling/check.py

Local server:

    http://127.0.0.1:8000

## Google Login

    GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=...
    GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=...
    GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI=https://domain.example/api/auth/google/callback

Untuk HTTPS:

    COOKIE_SECURE=1
    SESSION_SECRET=<random-secret-panjang>

Jangan menyimpan secret di repository.

## Validation

    npm run frontend:smoke
    python tooling/repository_audit.py
    python tooling/smoke.py
    python -m pytest -q -W error

CI menjalankan npm check, pip check, compileall, Ruff, pytest, dan runtime smoke.

## Batas keamanan

Project tidak membypass password, enkripsi, DRM, signature, private asset, atau access control.

Untuk format proprietary, tool hanya mengklaim kemampuan yang benar-benar tersedia. Export ZIP tidak berarti format native game telah dikonversi.

## Version

Game Mod Asset Lab v5.0.0
